verdict.rationale: a-Shell includes Vim as its terminal editor and explicitly documents running syntax checkers via vim-lsp or ALE, plus compilers (clang/clang++) for building code inside the app. Missing for 10: no evidence of built-in dedicated linters for common languages (e.g., pylint, eslint) beyond user-configured Vim plugins, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the vim-lsp/ALE setup actually working smoothly on iOS.
